params.name: picture
params.description: Picture for which to get information.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the picture expressed in pixels.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the picture expressed in pixels.

params.name: hOffset
params.description: Horizontal offset when displayed on background.

params.name: vOffset
params.description: Vertical offset when displayed on background.

params.name: mode
params.description: Transfer mode when displayed on background.

overloads.semanticRole: The PICTURE PROPERTIES command returns information about the picture you pass in picture .

constraints: hOffset, vOffset and mode only have meaning for a picture displayed 'On Background' in a form; they are otherwise not meaningful.
